analysis.advance: A candidate improvement alone is insufficient. Require positive final-task point gain and a CI95 lower bound above zero for advancement to a matched full-roster replication. Report strata and harms. A first positive result is a discovery lead, not stable gain.
analysis.attribution: Change the maximum generated distinct candidate count from three to five with the corresponding typed schema and prompt. Preserve minimum one, the original K8 intent-boundary selection, fixed Solver limits of 28 total values and 16 per candidate, native episode, Reviewer task-contract-only tool, decoding and roster. Historical control is from another service process; disclose that limitation. No knowledge-off arm.
analysis.failure: If candidate coverage or complete quality fails to improve, identify the failing component from the preregistered coverage-to-decision decomposition; do not sweep N or repeat until a gate passes. Track B may proceed as a separately admitted mechanism after this verdict.
analysis.inference: Pair by recording; cluster bootstrap by speaker, 10000 draws, seed 20260915. Use CI95 for task-quality advancement and CI90 for diagnostics. Preserve the prospective analysis recipe before task-quality reads.
analysis.primary: Complete official SLURP pooled micro-F1 compared with the released incumbent on the exact same 1080 rows.
secondary: Gold membership in the generated distinct candidate list, with actual width
Final intent accuracy conditional on gold membership, with denominator
Entity errors conditional on correct intent
Tool calls, revisions, invalid output, saturation, fallback and input volume
Natural-mixture and equal-scenario views, all 18 scenario strata
Generated coverage gap from 95 percent (at least 1026 of 1080), without treating this target as an achieved or sufficient result
Paired final-intent accuracy on the same rows where gold is covered in both arms, alongside each arm's own covered denominator
Candidate transitions: gained coverage, lost coverage, retained coverage and neither covered
Actual distinct width, duplicate/invalid candidates, delivered value count per candidate and input tokens; do not interpret narrow width as confidence

failure_policy: Stop and preserve on failure. Root must identify the failing component and reconcile contacts before any single recovery registration; a second failure closes this flight. No automatic restart, filtering, retry campaign, prompt change or geometry change.

fit.exact_request: Fit each immutable realized request before dispatch under the same lease, including actual role history and supplied values. No static whole-roster all-branch guarantee is claimed.

generation_budget.definition: Complete the unchanged maximum eleven-contact native program for every Fold A row. The ceiling is a conservative safety bound, not an estimated cost or a reusable global allowance.

inheritance: Compare with the retained maximum-three TRAIN Fold A anchor from another process. Full K8 prepared selection is identical despite reviewed shared-source upgrades. A first positive full-task result requires a separately registered matched-roster replication. No knowledge-off arm, broad-factored retry, dynamic-tools recovery or new-fold exposure.

facet_source.embedded_signal: text: sealed released TRAIN-derived intent-boundary facet vectors; the key side is knowledge text.

query_source.embedded_signal: speech: complete original TRAIN Fold A recordings represented by sealed full-utterance segments in the intent-boundary retrieval dimension; segment identities are preserved and no flattening, re-encoding, transcript, answer or future turn enters this query.

population.decision_population: Complete previously exposed TRAIN Fold A1080 only; both A/B remain excluded from runtime knowledge construction, and Fold B is not executed.

research_scope: Stage2 bounded discovery; frozen core; no new fold exposure, ASR, encoding or paid API.

scoring.release_gate: Seal full1080 output and first complete official score, then root binds the paired source release before reading task quality. Do not rerun the incumbent scorer.

service.switch: Root only at the reconciled E21 terminal boundary. E21 static fit was rejected before endpoints, its stale lease was reconciled, and E21 remains held. Require idle slots before stopping the old service.
